facts.text: Logan, you old grump, sit down and eat. The yellow suit looks great on you.
facts.why: Not found among Wade's lines on the quote page. When he sees Logan in the comics suit he says 'Ooh! Look at those jammies.' This one is printed in quote marks.

vibe.verdict: A fun Void cafe with Dogpool, Johnny Storm and the TVA, but the layout leaves a big gap in the header and the note is invented.
